purpose: Lock the service unit, non-AI comparison, whole-system boundary, time window, completion rule, group breakdown and accountable role before publishing any mobility intensity claim.

population_reference.rule: This reference links the contract screen to the population-scale stress replay; it is not a Haidian population measurement.

contract_rules.rule_zh: 合成压力屏可以比较路径和恢复规则，但不能替代有日期的本地计量、人工对照、责任确认或公众参与。
contract_rules.rule_en: The synthetic stress screen may compare paths and recovery rules, but it cannot replace dated local measurement, a staffed baseline, responsibility acceptance or public participation.

scenario_contracts.label_zh: 地铁中断时的一次完成通勤请求
scenario_contracts.label_en: one completed commute request during a metro disruption
scenario_contracts.service_unit_zh: 每名完成的跨方式到岗请求
scenario_contracts.non_ai_baseline_zh: 既有站务告知 + 公交、步行或无障碍人工绕行
scenario_contracts.non_ai_baseline_en: existing station notice plus staffed bus, walking or accessible reroute
scenario_contracts.whole_system_boundary_zh: 站务、公交供给、步行/无障碍路径、人工通知、设备与日志
scenario_contracts.whole_system_boundary_en: station service, bus supply, walk/accessibility path, human notice, devices and logs
scenario_contracts.time_window_zh: 合成早高峰应激窗口；现场须锁定日期和分钟粒度
scenario_contracts.time_window_en: synthetic AM stress window; field work must lock date and minute granularity
scenario_contracts.completion_rule_zh: 到达约定终点或完成有记录的人工接管；放弃、重复请求和未完成请求单独计数
scenario_contracts.completion_rule_en: reach the declared destination or complete a recorded human handoff; abandonment, retries and incomplete requests are counted separately
scenario_contracts.groups_zh: 居民、企业员工、照护同行、轮椅/无障碍、夜班与外部通勤
scenario_contracts.groups_en: residents, enterprise employees, carers, wheelchair/accessibility, night workers and external commuters
scenario_contracts.owner_needed_zh: 轨道/公交运营、企业服务和街道人工服务责任角色
scenario_contracts.owner_needed_en: rail/bus operator, enterprise service and staffed community-service roles

scenario_contracts.label_zh: 公交中断时的一次完成居民服务请求
scenario_contracts.label_en: one completed resident-service request during a bus disruption
scenario_contracts.service_unit_zh: 每名完成的门到门居民服务请求
scenario_contracts.service_unit_en: one completed door-to-door resident service request
scenario_contracts.non_ai_baseline_zh: 人工站点问询 + 既有轨道、步行/无障碍和电话服务
scenario_contracts.non_ai_baseline_en: staffed stop information plus existing rail, walk/accessibility and telephone service
scenario_contracts.whole_system_boundary_zh: 站点、轨道、步行/无障碍、电话人工、候车和替代车辆
scenario_contracts.whole_system_boundary_en: stops, rail, walk/accessibility, staffed telephone, waiting and substitute vehicles
scenario_contracts.time_window_zh: 合成工作日服务窗口；现场须锁定服务时段和等待起止
scenario_contracts.time_window_en: synthetic weekday service window; field work must lock service hours and wait start/end
scenario_contracts.completion_rule_zh: 完成居民声明的服务目的并安全返回或交接；未到达与取消不计为完成
scenario_contracts.completion_rule_en: complete the resident-declared purpose and return or hand over safely; missed arrivals and cancellations are not completions
scenario_contracts.groups_zh: 老年人、照护同行、低数字化入口、无障碍、儿童同行与普通居民
scenario_contracts.groups_en: older residents, carers, low-digital-access users, accessibility, children accompanied and general residents
scenario_contracts.owner_needed_zh: 公交/轨道运营、社区服务和人工电话入口责任角色
scenario_contracts.owner_needed_en: bus/rail operator, community service and staffed telephone-entry roles

scenario_contracts.label_zh: 雨雪天气的一次安全到达请求
scenario_contracts.label_en: one safe arrival request during severe weather
scenario_contracts.service_unit_zh: 每名完成的安全门到门出行请求
scenario_contracts.service_unit_en: one completed safe door-to-door trip request
scenario_contracts.non_ai_baseline_zh: 人工天气告知 + 可走的无障碍/步行路线 + 公共交通回退
scenario_contracts.non_ai_baseline_en: staffed weather notice plus a usable accessible/walking path and public-transit fallback
scenario_contracts.whole_system_boundary_zh: 天气信息、路面、坡道、照明、地铁/公交、人工求助与临时设施
scenario_contracts.whole_system_boundary_en: weather information, surfaces, ramps, lighting, rail/bus, human help and temporary equipment
scenario_contracts.time_window_zh: 合成极端天气窗口；现场须锁定天气事件、路段和观察时长
scenario_contracts.time_window_en: synthetic severe-weather window; field work must lock event, segments and observation duration
scenario_contracts.completion_rule_zh: 完成声明的到达并保持可通行/可求助；任一关键障碍触发停止且单列
scenario_contracts.completion_rule_en: complete the declared arrival while retaining access and help; any critical obstacle triggers a stop and separate count
scenario_contracts.groups_zh: 轮椅/无障碍、老人、儿童同行、步行者、自行车者与夜班人员
scenario_contracts.groups_en: wheelchair/accessibility, older residents, children accompanied, walkers, cyclists and night workers
scenario_contracts.owner_needed_zh: 道路维护、公共交通、照明和人工接管责任角色
scenario_contracts.owner_needed_en: road maintenance, public transport, lighting and human-handoff roles

scenario_contracts.label_zh: 路缘服务失效时的一次装卸或接驳请求
scenario_contracts.label_en: one loading or shuttle request during a curb-service failure
scenario_contracts.service_unit_zh: 每次完成且不占用消防/无障碍通道的路缘服务请求
scenario_contracts.service_unit_en: one completed curb-service request without blocking fire or accessible passage
scenario_contracts.non_ai_baseline_zh: 人工排班 + 公开路缘规则 + 现场人工清场
scenario_contracts.non_ai_baseline_en: staffed scheduling plus public curb rules and on-site manual clearing
scenario_contracts.whole_system_boundary_zh: 路缘、消防净空、无障碍通行、车队、装卸人员、告知和投诉
scenario_contracts.whole_system_boundary_en: curb, fire clearance, accessible passage, fleet, loading staff, notice and complaints
scenario_contracts.time_window_zh: 合成装卸/接驳窗口；现场须锁定预约、到达、清场和投诉时间
scenario_contracts.time_window_en: synthetic loading/shuttle window; field work must lock booking, arrival, clearing and complaint times
scenario_contracts.completion_rule_zh: 任务完成且公共通道持续可用；超时、越界、占道和未清场分别计数
scenario_contracts.completion_rule_en: complete the task while the public passage stays open; lateness, boundary crossing, blockage and uncleared states are counted separately
scenario_contracts.groups_zh: 居民、企业员工、物流人员、无障碍使用者、消防/维护人员
scenario_contracts.groups_en: residents, enterprise staff, logistics workers, accessibility users and fire/maintenance staff
scenario_contracts.owner_needed_zh: 路缘管理、企业车队、物流和现场清场责任角色
scenario_contracts.owner_needed_en: curb management, enterprise fleet, logistics and on-site clearing roles

scenario_contracts.label_zh: 跨边界通勤返程的一次完成请求
scenario_contracts.label_en: one completed cross-boundary return commute request
scenario_contracts.service_unit_zh: 每名完成的跨边界返程请求
scenario_contracts.non_ai_baseline_zh: 人工班次确认 + 轨道/公交 + 企业班车或电话回退
scenario_contracts.non_ai_baseline_en: staffed timetable confirmation plus rail/bus and enterprise shuttle or telephone fallback
scenario_contracts.whole_system_boundary_zh: 跨区轨道/公交、企业班车、换乘、夜班值守、电话人工与候车
scenario_contracts.whole_system_boundary_en: cross-boundary rail/bus, enterprise shuttle, transfers, night staffing, telephone help and waiting
scenario_contracts.time_window_zh: 合成晚高峰至夜班返程窗口；现场须锁定跨区 OD、班次和末班约束
scenario_contracts.time_window_en: synthetic PM-to-night return window; field work must lock cross-boundary OD, headways and last-service constraints
scenario_contracts.completion_rule_zh: 按声明目的完成返程并保留人工求助；错过末班、被迫改道和放弃分别计数
scenario_contracts.completion_rule_en: complete the return for the declared purpose with human help available; missed last service, forced reroute and abandonment are counted separately
scenario_contracts.groups_zh: 跨区员工、夜班人员、学生、照护同行、低收入与无障碍使用者
scenario_contracts.groups_en: cross-boundary employees, night workers, students, carers, low-income and accessibility users
scenario_contracts.owner_needed_zh: 轨道/公交运营、企业班车和夜间人工服务责任角色
scenario_contracts.owner_needed_en: rail/bus operator, enterprise shuttle and night staffed-service roles

claims.label_zh: 每次完成服务的能源或算力强度
claims.label_en: energy or compute intensity per completed service

claims.label_zh: 每客公里或每车公里强度
人工复核分钟与退出成本

air_candidate.rule_zh: 空中出行没有独立审批、地面接驳、人工回退、责任确认和可撤回证据时，不进入任何分母或强度比较。
air_candidate.rule_en: Air mobility stays outside every denominator and intensity comparison until independent approval, ground connection, human fallback, responsibility acceptance and reversible evidence exist.
